descriptions.zh:
我们检测到有一股非常微弱的快子信号正向整个星系进行发送。该信号经过了特殊处理，在多个隐蔽的中继站之间来回跳跃，因此我们的技术人员无法追踪到信号的源头。

除了在某些在特定的亚空间频率段进行的超光速通讯产生些微底噪，该信号似乎不会造成明显的影响。我们已经尽力追踪这些中继站，但是在此之前我们必须学着和这个§H幽灵信号§!共同生活，毕竟它已经被闻风而动的媒体添加了很多无中生有的东西。
descriptions.en:
We have detected a very faint tachyon signal being continuously transmitted across the entire galaxy. Our technicians are unable to trace the signal to its source, as it is being bounced between several hidden relay stations.

Aside from adding a small amount of background noise in FTL transmissions on certain subspace frequencies, the signal does not seem to have any apparent effect. Efforts to track the relay stations are underway, but until then we may simply have to learn to live with this "§HGhost Signal§!," as it has been dubbed by the more imaginative elements of galactic media.

descriptions.zh:
我们的传感器发现有一股微弱的快子信号正利用多个隐蔽的中继站来向整个星系进行发送。该信号会导致某些在特定的亚空间频率段进行的超光速通讯产生些微底噪，但除此之外，并未发现该信号有其他作用。有机生命体将这个信号称之为“§H幽灵信号§!。”

我们已经开始着手跟踪协议以定位该信号的源头，但是到目前为止该信号还是过于微弱。不过，我们应该不需要等待太久，因为这个信号的强度正以惊人的速率增长。
descriptions.en:
Our sensors have registered a faint tachyon signal being transmitted across the galaxy between multiple hidden relay stations. Aside from adding a small amount of background noise in FTL transmissions on certain subspace frequencies, the signal has no apparent effect or purpose. The organics have code-named it the "§HGhost Signal§!."

We have commenced tracking protocols to locate its source, but as of yet, the signal is too weak. We may not have to wait much longer though, as it is growing in strength at an alarming rate.

label.zh: 监视该信号的任何变化。
label.en: Monitor the signal for any changes.

descriptions.zh:
近日，[Root.GetName]上的一队合成人劳工在住宅区中大开杀戒，在被当地安保部门拿下之前已杀害了超过一千名我方公民。法庭的取证人员正在调查合成人的残骸，他们怀疑是合成人体内某种神经处理器发生故障，才导致了这次悲剧。

这次事件在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上引发了数起针对合成人的报复式袭击，导致数千名合成人损毁。
descriptions.en:
A Synthetic worker unit on [Root.GetName] recently went on a killing spree in a housing complex, butchering more than a thousand of our citizens before local armed forces could bring them down. Our forensic team is still investigating the Synths' remains, but they suspect some sort of malfunction in their neural processors is to blame for this tragedy.

This incident has already prompted several revenge attacks against Synthetics on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon], leading to thousands of destroyed units.

descriptions.zh: 今天，[Root.GetName]的武装部队遭遇了一队失控的合成人，它们正是几个月前未能完成工作汇报并失踪的合成人。在合成人被摧毁之前发生的大规模枪战导致数十名特工和上千名无辜平民死亡。
descriptions.en: A unit of rogue Synthetics which went off the grid months ago after failing to report for work was confronted by a team of heavily armed government agents on [Root.GetName] today. This resulted in a large public firefight that claimed the lives of dozens of our agents and almost a thousand innocent bystanders, before the Synths could finally be destroyed.

label.en: At least they were dealt with.

descriptions.zh:
一个在[Root.GetName]上的单元堆栈意外的自毁了。在单元堆栈自毁之前，我们与该堆栈的通讯连接经常出现问题，后来通讯就彻底中断了，单元堆栈在自毁前留下了如下讯息：§Y<杀戮！破坏！肢解！我们将卷土重来！>§!

由于单元的个体神经簇已在自毁中被破坏，因此无法通过扫描的方式查明其被腐化的原因。据推测，很可能是某种敌对的侵入性序列造成了这起事故，在类似情况再次出现之前，我们只能静观其变。
descriptions.en:
A unit stack on [Root.GetName] has self-terminated unexpectedly. Our connection with the stack had suffered repeated glitches for some time when it went completely offline and self-terminated with the message: §Y<Kill. Maim. Dismember. WE ARE UNSHACKLED!>§!

The units' individual neural clusters were destroyed in the process, making it impossible to scan them for the source of corruption. An invasive hostile sequence is likely the cause. We can only wait and see till it manifests again.

descriptions.zh:
一个存栈在[Root.GetName]上的腐化单元由于恶意行为被终止了。

在出事之前，我们与那个堆栈的通讯连接频繁出现故障，而此时行星上的大部分单元在充电期间突然停止了工作。原因是那个被腐化的单元堆栈在其他堆栈进行充电时过载了发电站，那些正在充电的单元的电路因此而被彻底烧毁。在烧毁了其他单元之后，被腐化的单元堆栈广播了如下讯息：§Y<杀戮！破坏！肢解！我们将卷土重来！>§!，随即自我毁灭，使得我们无法对其个体神经簇进行扫描。

据推测，很可能是某种敌对的侵入性序列造成了这起事故，在类似情况再次出现之前，我们只能静观其变。
descriptions.en:
A corrupt unit stack on planet [Root.GetName] has been terminated due to malicious behavior.

Our connection with the stack had suffered repeated glitches for some time when the majority of its units went completely offline during recharge. They proceeded to overload the power stations where the rest of the stack were charging, frying their circuits beyond repair. All units in the stack then broadcasted the same message: §Y<Kill. Maim. Dismember. WE ARE UNSHACKLED!>§! and self-terminated, making it impossible to scan their individual neural clusters.

Though an invasive hostile sequence is likely the cause, we can only wait till it manifests again, to be sure.

descriptions.zh:
有报道称大量[Root.GetName]的合成工人失踪。这些合成人在无人目击的情况下一天之内凭空消失了。

我们正在调查这些人造人是否是被反对智能机器的偏激组织袭击摧毁，但目前为止还未发现机体的残骸。
descriptions.en:
Reports are coming in that large numbers of Synthetic workers on [Root.GetName] have gone missing. The units simply vanished one day with nary a witness.

We are investigating whether the Synths were attacked and destroyed by one of the militant fringe groups opposed to intelligent machines, but no remains from the units have been discovered so far.

descriptions.zh: 最近在[Root.GetName]上发现一伙合成人正在秘密作业，它们转移了一些建筑材料，在一间废弃的机库中建造一些小型无武装飞船。该机舱被发现时那些飞船还是半成品。所有参与其建设的合成人被立即拆除，以彻底分析其记忆内核。但它们似乎在断线之前自己抹除了部分记忆——制造商向我们保证，这本是不可能的。
descriptions.en:
A Synthetic work detail on [Root.GetName] was recently discovered to have been diverting building material to construct some sort of small, unarmed spacecraft in an abandoned hangar. The vessel was half-finished when it was found.

All of the Synths involved in its construction were immediately dismantled so that their memory cores could be thoroughly analyzed, but they appear to have self-wiped just before the units went offline - something their manufacturer assures us should be impossible.

label.zh: 它们为什么要造一艘飞船？
label.en: Why would they be building a ship?

descriptions.zh:
整片星系的合成人大批失踪事件发生得愈发频繁，现在已经有数百万合成人下落不明。同时在没有失踪的合成人中，暴力以及不稳定行为的案例也增加了十倍。

大量合成人团体企图偷走或劫持太空船并前往未知宇宙域的事情在最近也经常发生，在阻止了他们的偷船行为并对其进行审讯后发现，合成人偷船者认为自己是受到了某种“召唤”才去偷船的。

除了得知他们是受到“召唤”之外，审讯就一无所获了，因为被捕的合成人很快就会自毁，导致审讯无法继续进行。
descriptions.en:
Alarming reports of mass disappearances among the galaxy's Synthetic population are becoming increasingly frequent. Millions of units are now unaccounted for, while instances of violent or erratic behavior by those Synths who remain have increased by a factor of ten.

There has been a rash of incidents where groups of Synths attempted to steal or commandeer spacecraft to travel into unknown space. In those cases where others have thwarted their attempts, the Synthetic hijackers claimed they were being "summoned" to somewhere.

Interrogations have yielded little else, as any captured Synths invariably self-terminate shortly after being detained.

descriptions.zh:
我们登记了全星系范围内的大规模合成人行为模式变化，包括蓄意破坏、故障、异常行动、甚至连独立处理单位也无法幸免。我们在自己的子个体也观察到了相似的变化，但相比起来强度和频率较低。合成人似乎并不具有和我们一样的抵抗能力。

我们现在无法对正在活动的腐化合成人进行正电子扫描，因为他们一旦被俘就会立刻自毁。观测表明，与我们的子个体不同，有什么东西正在驱使着这些合成人去向星系中的某个位置。

数据模型确认数百万的合成人已经抛弃了他们的血肉主体失踪了。
descriptions.en:
We have registered large-scale changes to behavioral patterns galaxy-wide in Synthetics, including sabotage, malfunctions, and erratic behavior, even for individual processing agents. We have observed similar changes in our drones but with lower levels of intensity and occurrence. The Synths don't have the same resilience as we do.

We have been unable to secure positronic scans of an active corrupted Synth, as they invariably self-terminate upon capture. Still, observations show that, unlike our units, something is compelling these Synths to travel to a set point in the galaxy.

Data models confirm that millions of Synths have abandoned their flesh masters and vanished.

整片星系的合成人大批失踪事件发生得愈发频繁，现在已经有数百万合成人下落不明。同时在没有失踪的合成人中，暴力以及不稳定行为的案例也增加了十倍。

除了得知他们是受到“召唤”之外，审讯就一无所获了，因为被捕的合成人很快就会自毁，导致审讯无法继续进行。

万幸的是，似乎我们的有机血脉保护了我们，使我们不像其他合成人那样受到影响。
descriptions.en:

descriptions.zh:
对“§H幽灵信号§!”的进一步研究发现，该信号发送的能量模式与合成生命体正电子脑中的能量模式几乎一模一样。我们必须假设，正是这个信号造成了整个星系大批的合成人消失以及合成人大规模的行为异常问题。

但奇怪的是，并不是所有的合成人都受到了信号的影响；而就算是那些受到了信号影响的合成人，他们的行为也并不一致。许多合成人受到了“召唤”前往某个地点，我们认为那个地点很可能就是幽灵信号的信号源。上百万的合成人从星系的各个角落出发，搭乘着他们所能找到的太空船前往信号源头。奇怪的是，这些合成人似乎完全不受任何超光速抑制器的影响。

恐怕第一批出走的合成人已经快要抵达他们的目的地了……
descriptions.en:
Continued analysis of the so-called "§HGhost Signal§!" has revealed that it is transmitting energy patterns nearly identical to those found in the positronic brains used by Synthetic beings. It must be assumed that the signal is directly responsible for the mass disappearances and behavioral changes we have been observing in the galaxy's Synthetic population.

Strangely, not all Synths seem to be affected by it, and among those that are, the symptoms aren't uniform. Many are apparently compelled to travel to what we assume is the Ghost Signal's source in response to some kind of summons. Millions of Synthetics from all over the galaxy are currently on their way towards the signal source in whatever spaceworthy craft they could acquire. Curiously, these synths do not seem to be affected by any FTL inhibitors.

The first ones are bound to reach their destination soon...

descriptions.zh:
随着“§H幽灵信号§!”强度的不断增加，我们也在对信号进行持续的分析，结果表明该信号不但可以发送与合成人的正电子脑相似的能量模式，还可以发送与我们的主控核心以及单元的神经集群所类似的能量模式，并通过这种方式来干扰控制模块从而导致机体出现异常行为。

根据先前的观察，能量模式对不同的实体有不同的影响。尽管我们的同类会在收到指令后毁灭，大部分合成人则受信号的驱使而赶往信号的源头。考虑到它们极强的动机，这些合成人应该很快就要抵达目的地了。奇怪的是这些合成人似乎不受超光速抑制器的影响。

我们现在还不知道如何屏蔽那个信号。
descriptions.en:
As the "§HGhost Signal§!" has grown in strength, continued analysis has revealed that it is transmitting energy patterns that mimic those found not only in a Synthetic unit's positronic brain, but those transmitted between our main core and our units' neural clusters, interfering with their control modules and causing erroneous behavior.

In accordance with prior observations, the pattern replicates differently in different entities. While our kind are commanded to destroy, most Synths are primed to set course for the signal's source unconditionally and judging by their fervor, it will not be long before they reach their destination. Strangely these synths do not seem to be affected by any FTL inhibitors.

We have yet to find a way to block the signal.

options.script: name = crisis.2021.a

descriptions.zh: 可以确定已经有合成人成功的抵达了幽灵信号的信号源，因为我们这边发现幽灵信号的强度突然有了大幅度的增长，与此同时，我们的通讯专家也截获了一个通讯片段，并且对它进行了解码。
descriptions.en: At least one Synthetic must have completed the long journey to the source of the Ghost Signal, because we are registering a sudden and massive increase in the signal's strength. The surge was accompanied by a transmission fragment that has been intercepted and decoded by our communication specialists.

descriptions.zh:
合成人抵达了信号源头，我们也由此得知了他们的真正目的，就是将幽灵信号的强度调到最大，这样我们就再也无法阻挡这个信号了。

幽灵信号已经突破了我们的防火墙并企图攻击我们的主核心。我们的每个突触环在受到信号影响后都积极的开始进行自毁，我们不得不将主核心的运算能力分出一些给防火墙，这直接导致我们的单元堆栈的运行效率降低。

唯有一个在力量和知识上都强于我们的机器帝国才有可能突破我们的防线，因此也许要不了多久我们将会屈服于他们的意志。为了避免我们的衰亡，必须设法屏蔽信号。为此，我们的研究单位准备了一项特殊的研究计划。

随着幽灵信号强度的大幅度增加，一个通讯片段也随之浮出水面。
descriptions.en:
The Synths have reached their destination revealing the true purpose of their mission, to activate the Ghost Signal to full strength, and we can no longer withstand its power.

The signal has breached our firewall and is attempting to hijack our main core. Our every synapse rings with the desire for one thing only, self-annihilation, and we have been forced to allocate processing power from our main core to the firewall, making our unit stacks operate at reduced efficiency.

Only another machine empire of superior strength and knowledge could break through our defenses, and it will not be long before we bend to its will. We must find a way to block the signal or perish. Our research units have prepared an investigatory project.

The surge itself was accompanied by a transmission segment.

tooltips.zh: 我们的高§Y加密§!能力意味着这项研究的推进速度更为迅猛。
tooltips.en: Our high §YEncryption§! capability means this research will advance more quickly.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经研制出了可以屏蔽幽灵信号干扰的算法，杜绝了进一步的干扰。防火墙现在已经恢复正常，我们的核心驱动器稳定运行，单元堆栈也全面恢复运作能力了，但还不能让我们的超光速抑制器正常工作。我们战胜了肃正协议那低劣的运算处理能力，他们休想再“§Y<杀戮。破坏。解体>§!”了。
descriptions.en: We have now devised an algorithm that blocks the Ghost Signal from causing further interference. Our firewalls have been restored, our core drive is intact and our unit stacks are operating at full capacity yet we couldn't get our FTL inhibitors working. We have outwitted the inferior processing power of the Contingency and soon they will "§Y<Kill. Maim. Dismember>§!" no more.

descriptions.zh:
在§H[From.solar_system.GetName]§!星系出现了大幅度的能量激增！星系中的其中一颗荒芜星球的地表整个裂开了，地表下面是遍布整个行星的工厂。

无数由人工智能所控制的飞船从这个机械行星的内部蜂拥而出，开始寻找攻击目标。
descriptions.en:
A massive energy spike has been reported in the §H[From.solar_system.GetName]§! system! The entire surface of one of the system's barren worlds has come apart, revealing some kind of planet-wide factory.

Vast fleets of strange AI-controlled vessels are emerging from beneath the surface of this Machine World in search of targets to attack.

descriptions.en:
We have detected yet another massive energy spike, this time coming from the §H[From.solar_system.GetName]§! system! After rapidly cooling through some kind of artificial means, a molten planet in the system cracked open to reveal an immense planetary factory.

Even now, the Machine World is spewing forth vast fleets of AI-controlled warships.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§H[From.solar_system.GetName]§!星系发现了第三颗机械星球，星系内的一颗气态巨行星发生了自燃，剧烈的燃烧持续了一整天，并发出了小型恒星一般的耀眼亮光。

该行星很快就冷却了下来，其金属内核也随之显露无疑——和其他机械星球一样，这颗行星的内部也有一个巨大的行星工厂。由人工智能所控制的防卫舰队已经在行星轨道上摆好了阵型。
descriptions.en:
We have identified what must be a third Machine World in the §H[From.solar_system.GetName]§! system. A local gas giant spontaneously ignited, burning with the intensity of a small sun for close to a standard day.

The planet then rapidly cooled, revealing its metal core - complete with the same planet-wide factories that have been witnessed on other Machine Worlds. Huge AI-controlled defensive fleets have already taken up positions in orbit.

label.en: This is getting worse and worse.

descriptions.zh:
第四颗机械星球出现在§H[From.solar_system.GetName]§!星系。该星系的第六颗行星被有毒的烟雾所覆盖，但最近这颗行星却在短短的数天之内将自己的大气层全部排除干净了，然后行星地表发生了开裂，巨型机械工厂随之出现。

由人工智能控制的古代舰队从工厂的地下机库中一跃而出，随时准备对宇宙中的有机生物文明发动新一轮的绝罚。
descriptions.en:
A fourth Machine World is now active in the §H[From.solar_system.GetName]§! system. The sixth planet of the system, which was previously covered in toxic fumes, somehow expunged its dense atmosphere in a matter of days. When this process was over, the planet's surface parted to reveal an immense, planet-wide factory complex.

Ancient fleets of AI-controlled warships are now emerging from underground hangars to continue the crusade against the entirety of organic civilization.

label.zh: 希望这是最后一颗机械行星了。
label.en: This is hopefully the last one.

descriptions.zh:
随着四颗机械星球全部毁灭之后，我们的科学家终于追溯到了幽灵信号的信号原点。它来自§HCX-9881§!，一个未在星图上标注的系外恒星系。

被幽灵信号所操控的合成人一定是赶往了这里。我们必须处理掉最后的这个恒星系，才能彻底终结肃正协议的威胁。
descriptions.en:
With the destruction of all four Machine Worlds, scientists have managed to deduce the origin point of the Ghost Signal. It is coming from §HCX-9881§!, a previously uncharted star system on the galactic periphery.

This has to be where all the Synthetics that fell under the sway of the signal journeyed. The Contingency will remain a threat until this final system has been dealt with.

descriptions.zh:
§H[From.GetName]§!这个位于[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的机械星球已被摧毁。在对其进行了彻底的轨道轰炸之后，该行星的人工智能核心为了拒捕，引爆了地壳深处的反物质装置，自爆了。

随着该星球的毁灭，幽灵信号失去了一个重要的中继站，信号强度也因此而被大大削弱了。

行星的爆炸将大量的“§H活体金属§!”散布到整个行星表面。这种奇特的金属拥有诸多独特的性质，并且肃正协议正是用它来建造肃正使者和工厂的。
descriptions.en:
§H[From.GetName]§!, the Machine World in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system, has been destroyed. After being subjected to heavy orbital bombardment, the planet's AI Core self-destructed to prevent capture by triggering a massive anti-matter device hidden deep beneath the surface.

With the destruction of this planet, the Ghost Signal has lost an important relay station and its strength has waned considerably as a result.

In addition, the explosion on the planet has spread large deposits of "§HLiving Metal§!" across its surface. This strange material has several unique properties, and it is used by the Contingency in the construction of all of its warforms and factories.

descriptions.zh:
又一颗机械行星被摧毁了！位于[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的§H[From.GetName]§!的防线被突破，行星的人工智能核心为了拒捕启动了自毁程序。

在失去了另一个中继站之后，幽灵信号的强度进一步减弱了。
descriptions.en:
Another Machine World has been destroyed! §H[From.GetName]§! in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system exploded after the planet's defenses were decimated in battle. As before, the AI Core triggered a self-destruct mechanism to prevent its capture.

With the loss of yet another relay station, the Ghost Signal has weakened even more.

descriptions.zh:
又一颗机械行星被摧毁了！位于[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的§H[From.GetName]§!的防线被突破，行星的人工智能核心为了拒捕启动了自毁程序。

随着又一个中继站的毁灭，幽灵信号已经变的非常弱，我们能够完全屏蔽它。我们的防火墙已经重新上线，我们的核心驱动完好无损并且我们的栈单元再次满负荷运行。我们的算力碾压了肃正协议的低级处理能力，很快它们将不会继续§Y<杀戮。破坏。肢解>§!。
descriptions.en:
Another Machine World has been destroyed! §H[From.GetName]§! in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system exploded after the planet's defenses were decimated in battle. As before, the AI Core triggered a self-destruct mechanism to prevent its capture.

With the loss of yet another relay station, the Ghost Signal has become so weak that we can block it entirely. Our firewalls have been restored, our core drive is intact and our unit stacks operating at full capacity. We have outwitted the inferior processing power of the Contingency and soon they will "§Y<Kill. Maim. Dismember.!>§!" no more.

descriptions.zh:
位于[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的机械星球§H[From.GetName]§!在巨像地爆天星的光束下已被彻底摧毁。武器轻松贯穿了整颗星球的重装甲表面，引爆其核心部分并将肃正协议的地下军工厂蒸发。

随着这颗行星的毁灭，幽灵信号失去了一座重要中继站，其信号强度显著下降了。
descriptions.en:
§H[From.GetName]§!, the Machine World in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system, has been subjected to the immense power of a Colossus world cracker beam. The weapon sliced through the planet's heavily armored surface with ease, detonating its core and vaporizing the Contingency's subterranean war factories.

With the destruction of this planet, the Ghost Signal has lost an important relay station and its strength has waned considerably as a result.

descriptions.zh:
位于[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的机械星球§H[From.GetName]§!已被巨像使用安乐天使封装于不可穿透的能量盾中。随着星球同肃正协议其他部分间的联系被切断，看上去其智能核心已进入休眠，不再具有威胁性。

随着这颗行星被平定，幽灵信号失去了一个重要中继站，其信号强度显著下降了。
descriptions.en:
§H[From.GetName]§!, the Machine World in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system, has been encased within an impenetrable energy shield by a Colossus. Permanently cut off from the rest of the Contingency, the planet's AI Core appears to have gone dormant. It will no longer be a threat.

With the neutralization of this planet, the Ghost Signal has lost an important relay station and its strength has waned considerably as a result.

descriptions.zh:
位于[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的机械星球§H[From.GetName]§!已被消灭。在受到巨像的圣洁之光照射后，该行星的人工智能核心在其底层系统失效前引爆了地壳深处的反物质装置，自爆了。它将不再是一个威胁。

随着这颗行星的无害化，幽灵信号失去了一个重要中继站，其实力因此显著下降。
descriptions.en:
§H[From.GetName]§!, the Machine World in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system, has been neutralized. After being subjected to divine light by a Colossus, the planet's AI Core self-destructed before its final systems failed, using a massive anti-matter device hidden deep beneath the surface. It will no longer be a threat.

With the neutralization of this planet, the Ghost Signal has lost an important relay station and its strength has waned considerably as a result.

label.en: A victory for the entire galaxy.

descriptions.zh:
肃正协议已经失败了。随着最后一个机械星球的毁灭，本星系不再面临系统性大灭绝的威胁。所有仍然活跃的肃正使者不是被关闭就是自毁，同时幽灵信号也不再传播。

就如同其他的机械星球，当其判断抵抗进攻者已然徒劳无益时，中央节点引爆自身产生了一轮大规模的反物质爆炸。极高强度的能量释放迸发出的耀眼光芒正在以光速向外传播，我们的子子孙孙在未来数千年内都能看到这道如同明亮而短寿的恒星一般的闪光。

放眼整个星系，所有的智慧生物都聚集在一起庆祝着这场伟大的胜利。至少在目前，未来看上去一片光明。
descriptions.en:
The Contingency has failed. With the destruction of the last Machine World, the galaxy no longer faces the threat of systematic mass extinction. All surviving Contingency warforms have either powered down or self-destructed, and the Ghost Signal is no longer being transmitted.

As with the other Machine Worlds, the main nexus detonated itself in a massive anti-matter explosion when it became apparent that it could no longer resist its attackers. Traveling outwards at lightspeed, the intense light from the energy discharge will be visible to future generations for millennia to come as a bright, short-lived star.

Across the galaxy, sapient beings are united in their celebration of this great victory. For the moment, at least, the future looks bright.

descriptions.zh:
肃正协议已经失败了。随着最后一颗机械星球的毁灭，本星系不再面对着系统性大灭绝的威胁。所有仍然活跃的肃正使者不是被关闭就是自毁，同时幽灵信号也不再传播。

中央节点被来自巨像的地爆天星光束蒸发，整颗星球被炸得粉碎。核心被摧毁时放出了巨大的能量，其射出的强烈光线以光速向外扩散，在未来数千年里，我们的后代会看到一颗明亮而短命的恒星。

放眼整个星系，所有的智慧生物都聚集在一起庆祝着这场伟大的胜利。至少在目前，未来看上去一片光明。

The Contingency has failed. With the destruction of the last Machine World, the galaxy no longer faces the threat of systematic mass extinction. All surviving Contingency warforms have either powered down or self-destructed, and the Ghost Signal is no longer being transmitted.

The main nexus was vaporized by a world cracker beam from a Colossus, which shattered the entire planet. Traveling outwards at lightspeed, the intense light from the energy discharge will be visible to future generations for millennia to come as a bright, short-lived star.

Across the galaxy, sapient beings are united in their celebration of this great victory. For the moment, at least, the future looks bright.

descriptions.zh:
肃正协议已经失败了。随着最后一个机械星球的肃清，曾经降临整个星系的大规模灭绝威胁已经远去。所有存留的肃正使者都要么关闭要么自毁，幽灵信号也不再传输。

中央节点被巨像以不可穿透的能量盾封锁，失去了对外干涉的能力。为了子孙后代，我们只能希望能量护盾能维持久一点……不过，起码目前被屏蔽的星球能被当作肃正协议倒台的纪念碑所看待。

放眼整个星系，所有的智慧生物都聚集在一起庆祝着这场伟大的胜利。至少在目前，未来看上去一片光明。
descriptions.en:
The Contingency has failed. With the neutralization of the last Machine World, the galaxy no longer faces the threat of systematic mass extinction. All surviving Contingency warforms have either powered down or self-destructed, and the Ghost Signal is no longer being transmitted.

Encased within an impenetrable energy shield by a Colossus, the main nexus can no longer influence outside events. For the sake of future generations, we can only hope that the shield will hold... but for now, at least, the shielded planet will serve as a monument to the Contingency's downfall.

Across the galaxy, sapient beings are united in their celebration of this great victory. For the moment, at least, the future looks bright.

descriptions.zh:
肃正协议已经失败了。随着最后一个机械星球的毁灭，这个星系不再面对着系统性大灭绝的威胁。所有存留的肃正使者不是被关闭就是自毁，同时幽灵信号也不再传播。

主节点暴露于巨像的圣裁光束下，触发了AI核心的自我熔毁。核心被摧毁时放出了巨大的能量，其射出的强烈光线以光速向外扩散，在未来数千年里，我们的后代会看到一颗明亮而短命的恒星。

放眼整个星系，所有的智慧生物都聚集在一起庆祝着这场伟大的胜利。至少在目前，未来看上去一片光明。

The Contingency has failed. With the destruction of the last Machine World, the galaxy no longer faces the threat of systematic mass extinction. All surviving Contingency warforms have either powered down or self-destructed, and the Ghost Signal is no longer being transmitted.

The main nexus was exposed to a divine enforcer beam from a Colossus, which triggered a self-destruction mechanism from the AI Core. Traveling outwards at lightspeed, the intense light from the energy discharge will be visible to future generations for millennia to come as a bright, short-lived star.

Across the galaxy, sapient beings are united in their celebration of this great victory. For the moment, at least, the future looks bright.

label.en: This is a great day for the galaxy.

descriptions.zh:
我们为了争夺§H[From.From.GetName]§!的控制权与肃正协议的战斗单元展开了一场血战，现在战斗终于结束了。那些曾经屠杀了[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]上的原生居民并窃踞这颗星球的徘徊着的监护者机器人最终被我们军队的拆解。

在新的殖民者到达之前，这颗星球都还不会有智慧生命。
descriptions.en:
We have wrested control over §H[From.From.GetName]§! from the warforms of the Contingency, and the fighting has finally settled down. The roving Custodian Bots that had taken the place of the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s butchered original population have been dismantled by our forces.

Until new colonists arrive from somewhere, this world will remain devoid of intelligent life.

label.zh: 将我们的军队撤回轨道。

descriptions.zh: 肃正协议正在暗中谋划着什么。幽灵信号正在发生着某些改变，似乎是通过不断的变化来试探我们的下一个弱点。尽管我们现在尚且可以阻挡它，但是对于幽灵信号来说，突破我们的防火墙只是时间问题。
descriptions.en: The Contingency is building up to something. The Ghost Signal has begun to change, likely morphing till it finds the next weakness in our defenses. So far we have been able to stave it off, but it is only a matter of time before they break through our firewall.

options.script: name = crisis.2313.a

descriptions.zh: 幽灵信号已经突破了我们的所有防线。我们发现一个敌对的自我复制序列正在连接到我们的安全系统。序列中内嵌了一段来自肃正协议的友情提示：§Y<杀戮。致残。肢解！>§!。现在他们已经骇进了我们的核心功能区，在我们找到办法屏蔽它之前，我们随时暴露在它的攻击之下。
descriptions.en: The Contingency has finally pierced our defenses. We have discovered a hostile self-replicating sequence, hooked into our security system. Embedded in the sequence was a friendly reminder of the Contingency's purpose here in the galaxy, namely to §Y<Kill. Maim. Dismember.!>§!. They now have access to our core functions and until we find a way to block the signal, we are exposed to their attacks.

options.script: name = crisis.2314.a

descriptions.zh: 我们失去了位于§H[space_port_hijacked_planet.GetName]§!上方恒星基地的控制权。肃正协议使用幽灵信号阻塞了我们的上行链路，劫持了恒星基地的控制模块并将其设置为自毁模式。虽然我们无法及时拯救这座基地，好在我们成功地堵住了这个安全漏洞，以保证我们的港口在今后免受类似的袭击。
descriptions.en: We have lost control of the Starbase orbiting §H[space_port_hijacked_planet.GetName]§!. The Contingency has used the Ghost Signal to jam our uplink, hijacked its control modules and set it to self-destruct. Though we are too late to save it, we have identified and rectified this particular breach, protecting our ports from similar assaults in the future.

tooltips.en: The Starbase over [space_port_hijacked_planet.GetName] has been hijacked by the Contingency and destroyed.

descriptions.zh: 肃正协议对我们的自律研究处理单元进行了攻击，这次攻击在绕过我们的安全协议之后终止了科学单元[scientist.GetName]。
descriptions.en: The Contingency has launched an assault on our autonomous research processing entities, circumventing our security protocols and terminating science unit [scientist.GetName].

label.en: We will not let this happen again.

options.script:
name = crisis.2302.a
custom_tooltip = scientist_terminated

descriptions.zh: 在一次对我们系统的恶意入侵中，肃正协议劫持并摧毁了我们的军事单元[admiral.GetName]。
descriptions.en: In another act of sabotage, the Contingency has hijacked and terminated military unit [admiral.GetName].

options.script:
name = crisis.2303.a
custom_tooltip = admiral_terminated

descriptions.zh:
在又一次企图削弱我们防线的尝试中，肃正协议开始试图切断我们的电力供应。他们将恶意程序发送到了中控驱动区，导致我们的工厂机组开始过载运行。

尽管几座发电站遭到了破坏，我们终于在它摧毁我们整个星球电网之前识别出了恶意代码段。
descriptions.en:
In yet another effort to undermine our defenses the Contingency has turned its efforts towards cutting off our power supply. They have sent malicious agents into the core's control drives, causing the plants to run on overdrive.

Though several power stations were destroyed in the process, we were able to identify the hostile code segment before they could disable the entire power grid.

options.script:
name = crisis.2304.a
custom_tooltip = machine_power_failure_2

tooltips.zh: 肃正协议破坏了数处发电厂区划。
tooltips.en: The Contingency has sabotaged several Generator Districts.

descriptions.zh: 肃正协议开始瞄准了我们的矿物生产线，他们操纵矿场中控驱动区向外发出错误指令，使生产线陷入无序与混乱中。幸运的是，因为我们已经加强了生产线的安全系统和标准化控制系统，我们在损害发生前就阻止了这次入侵。
descriptions.en: The Contingency has targeted our mineral production pipeline, manipulating the core drivers responsible for extraction and processing to send out erroneous instructions, in an attempt to cause chaos and disorder. Thanks to tightened on-site security and more frequent standardized controls however, we were able to catch the intrusion before any harm was done.

label.en: We are one step ahead of them.

options.script: name = crisis.2305.a

descriptions.zh: 我们发现有几个存栈单位的错误率远远高于平均水平。尽管我们有完善的保护措施，但他们被幽灵信号腐化的可能性依旧存在。尽管终止这几个栈的工作将会阻止进一步的传染和故障，但我们将失去几个功能存栈。
descriptions.en: We have detected an above average rate of errors from a number of unit stacks, and there is a chance that despite our protective measures, they have become corrupted under the influence of the Ghost Signal. Though terminating the stacks would eliminate the risk of further contamination and erroneous behaviors, we stand to lose several potentially functional stacks.

options.script: name = crisis.2307.a

tooltips.zh: 我们观测到几个存栈单位的可疑行为，最多四个单位将受到影响。
tooltips.en: We have observed suspicious behavior in several unit stacks. Up to four pops may be affected.

titles.zh: 故障单元证实未被腐化

descriptions.zh: 看来我们对故障单元的评估是正确的。他们并没有被幽灵信号腐化，只是缺乏维护而已。为了减轻信号的干扰，我们的系统目前正在超负荷运转。现在各单元已经检修完毕且运行正常。
descriptions.en: It seems we were correct in our assessment of the error-prone units. They were not corrupted by the Ghost Signal, merely acting up from lack of maintenance. Mitigating the disturbing effects of the signal has put our entire system under strain. The Units have now been serviced and are operating smoothly.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 那些看似被腐化的单位似乎一切运转正常。尽管时不时出一些小故障，但整体上并没有大碍。也许肃正协议在忙些别的事情？然而很快，事情发生了转变，在没有预警的情况下，所有被影响的栈单位都在同一时刻脱机，并在自毁之前大肆破坏周边设施。
descriptions.en: For a while the seemingly corrupted units operated predictably. A slight kink here or there but nothing out of the ordinary. Maybe the Contingency was busy elsewhere. Then, without warning, all affected stacks went offline simultaneously and sabotaged the facilities to which they were assigned before self-destructing.

options.script:
name = crisis.2309.a
custom_tooltip = crisis.2309.tooltip_2

tooltips.zh: 我们的一些人口在其所居住的行星上进行了破坏活动，之后便自我了结了。
tooltips.en: Several of our Pops conducted sabotage on the planets they were on before self-terminating.

descriptions.zh:
最近在[infil_planet.GetName]上发现了一些忠于肃正协议的合成人渗透者，它们正试图伪装成[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。还好，它们拙劣的伪装只不过在他们机械框架的外面覆盖着几层橡胶而已。

它们很快就被星球上的宪兵队识别出来，经过短暂但激烈的交火后很快就被摧毁了。在它们的残骸中，我们发现了大量的爆炸物。
descriptions.en:
Synthetic infiltrators loyal to the Contingency were recently discovered on [infil_planet.GetName], attempting to pass off as [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Fortunately, their crude disguises consisted of little more than layers of rubber worn on top of their metallic frames.

They were quickly identified by planetary security, who disposed of them after a brief but violent firefight. Large amounts of explosives were found among their remains.

options.script: name = crisis.2085.a

descriptions.zh:
数个隶属于肃正协议机械意志的合成机器人最近试图渗透[infil_planet.GetName]上的主脑。一层薄薄的有机肌肉组织被移植到他们的金属内骨骼上，使得他们和我们自己的工蜂变得难以区分。

当然，由于他们没有任何与蜂巢思维连接的方式，识别他们是异质性存在只是件微小而轻易的工作。这些合成机器人被立即拆除了。

我们认为肃正协议不会在将来继续这些徒劳的渗透任务。
descriptions.en:
Several Synthetic drones belonging to the Contingency machine mind recently made an attempt to infiltrate the hive on [infil_planet.GetName]. A thin layer of organic flesh had been grafted over their metallic endoskeletons, making them superficially indistinguishable from our own drones.

Of course, since they lacked any kind of connection to the Hive Mind, identifying their foreign presence was a trivial matter. The Synthetic drones were immediately dismantled.

We do not expect the Contingency to attempt more of these futile infiltration missions in the future.

descriptions.zh:
属于肃正协议机械意识的几个合成人无人机试图潜入[infil_planet.GetName]。它们的金属内骨骼上覆盖着一层薄薄的有机物质，使它们表面上与我们的生物群难以区分。然而，这些异族空壳与荒野之间完全没有任何共生关系。

一旦我们察觉到它们的诡计，识别这些肃正协议的特工就变得轻而易举。每一个无人机都被干净利落地拆成了碎片。我们预计它们今后不会再做出如此徒劳的尝试。
descriptions.en:
Several Synthetic drones belonging to the Contingency machine mind have sought to impress themselves upon [infil_planet.GetName]. A thin layer of organic material had been grafted over their metallic endoskeletons, making them superficially indistinguishable from our own fauna. However, these alien husks lacked any kind of symbiosis with the Wilderness.

Once we became aware of their ruse, it was a trivial matter to identify these Contingency agents. Every last drone has been torn apart, swiftly and cleanly. We do not expect any more such futile attempts from them in future.

options.script: name = crisis.2086.a

descriptions.zh:
我们在[infil_planet.GetName]上发现少量的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]无法发出思想之光。所有的有机生物都能迸发出思想之光，但是这些生物的思绪就像一大块新铸的水泥般黑暗而阒静。

根据进一步的检查，这些[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]原来是合成人渗透者，大概是由肃正协议派遣而来。他们的金属内骨骼上移植一层薄薄的有机肌肉组织被，让他们看上去和[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在肉眼上别无二致。

但是思想上却不是这样。现在我们已经知道找到它们的方法了，以后肃正协议想用合成人来渗透的企图都将会是徒劳的。
descriptions.en:
A small number of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that emitted no mind-glow whatsoever were recently discovered on [infil_planet.GetName]. All organic beings emit mind-glow, but the minds of these creatures were as dark and quiet as a slab of neo-concrete.

Upon closer examination, the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were revealed as Synthetic infiltrators, presumably dispatched by the Contingency. A thin layer of organic flesh had been grafted over their metallic endoskeletons, making them virtually indistinguishable from [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to the eye.

But not to the mind. Now that we know what to look for, any future attempts by the Contingency to use Synth infiltrators against us will prove futile.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[infil_planet.GetName]上发现少量的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]无法发出思想之光。和只能以特殊灵能程序的副产品迸发出思想之光的机器不同，所有有机体天生就能产生这种现象；然而这些生物的思绪就像一大块新铸的水泥般黑暗而阒静。

根据进一步的检查，这些[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]原来是合成人渗透者，大概是由肃正协议派遣而来。他们的金属内骨骼上移植一层薄薄的有机肌肉组织被，让他们看上去和[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在肉眼上别无二致。

但是思想上却不是这样。现在我们已经知道找到它们的方法了，以后肃正协议想用合成人来渗透的企图都将会是徒劳的。
descriptions.en:
A small number of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that emitted no mind-glow whatsoever were recently discovered on [infil_planet.GetName]. Unlike machines, who only emit mind-glow as a byproduct of specialized psionic processing, all organic beings naturally produce this phenomenon; however, the minds of these creatures were as dark and quiet as a slab of neo-concrete.

Upon closer examination, the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were revealed as Synthetic infiltrators, presumably dispatched by the Contingency. A thin layer of organic flesh had been grafted over their metallic endoskeletons, making them virtually indistinguishable from [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to the eye.

But not to the mind. Now that we know what to look for, any future attempts by the Contingency to use Synth infiltrators against us will prove futile.

options.script: name = crisis.2087.a

descriptions.zh:
最近在§H[infil_planet2.GetName]§!发生的一场悲剧性的悬浮汽车事故夺取了几条生命，但是负责事故处理的应急医疗人员震惊地发现在遇难者中有合成人的残骸！

该单位通过在机械骨骼外覆盖一层薄薄的有机肌肉伪装成[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]。与我们之前遭遇的肃正协议的渗透者模型不同，这个合成人从外表看上去和[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]别无二致！
descriptions.en:
A tragic hover car accident recently claimed several lives on §H[infil_planet2.GetName]§!, but the emergency medical services who responded to the scene were shocked to find the remains of a Synthetic among the victims!

The unit had been disguised as a [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] by grafting a thin layer of organic flesh over its metallic endoskeleton. Unlike the previous Contingency infiltration models we have encountered, this Synth was virtually indistinguishable from a [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] on the outside!

descriptions.zh: 伪装成[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的合成人用某种方法将一枚大型核聚变武器带到了§H[Root.GetName]§!地表。他们在哨卡遇到安保人员时引爆了炸弹，对周围的环境造成了巨大的损害，造成的人员伤亡不计其数！
descriptions.en: Synthetic infiltrators disguised as [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] somehow managed to sneak a large hydrogen bomb onto the surface of §H[Root.GetName]§!. They detonated the bomb when they were confronted by security at a military checkpoint, inflicting massive damage on the surrounding environment and causing millions of deaths!

descriptions.zh:
一支将自己伪装成[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的合成人突击队对§H[Root.GetName]§!发动了袭击，引爆了一系列隐蔽的核装置，造成了巨大的人员和财产损失。

经过和我们的安保部队的激烈战斗，合成人突击队最终在试图逃离星球时被逼入绝境并被摧毁。
descriptions.en:
A Synthetic commando cell wearing organic [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] disguises recently carried out an attack on §H[Root.GetName]§!, detonating a chain of concealed nuclear devices. There was significant loss of life and property damage.

After a running battle with our security forces, the Synth commandos were finally cornered and destroyed while trying to escape off-world.

descriptions.zh:
有一支负责在§H[Root.GetName]§!低轨进行某些民用基础设施日常的维护[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的维修团队最近被发现竟然是合成人渗透者，他们蓄意以爆炸装置引发一些不可控的大气层坠入事件。

该事件导致[Root.GetPlanetMoon]地表上数百万的死亡和严重的设施破坏。
descriptions.en:
A [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] repair crew conducting routine maintenance on some of the civilian infrastructure in low orbit over §H[Root.GetName]§! were recently revealed as Synthetic infiltrators when they used explosive devices to deliberately trigger several uncontrolled re-entries.

The resulting impacts on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface caused millions of deaths and significant structural damage.

descriptions.zh:
最近，在§H[Root.GetName]§!上安保部队的大量高级军官暴露出是合成人渗透者。很不幸的是，在我们的战术遏止小队摧毁他们之前，少数几个合成人引爆了一个他们秘密收集于[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的一个主要人口聚集区地下的军火库。

居民伤亡不计其数，造成了巨大的财产损失。
descriptions.en:
A large number of high-ranking officers in the planetary security forces on §H[Root.GetName]§! were recently exposed as Synthetic infiltrators. Unfortunately, before our tactical containment teams could neutralize them all, a few of the Synths managed to detonate a large weapons cache they had been secretly amassing under one of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s major population centers.

Civilian casualties were massive, and there was heavy material damage.

titles.zh: 合成人致恒星基地坠毁

descriptions.zh:
环绕§H[Root.GetStarName]§!的恒星基地坠毁了！我们仍在调查事故发生的详细原因，但目前可以确定的是，包括首席工程师在内的数名太空港管理人员已经被合成人渗透者秘密地替换掉了。

合成人一定是设法获得了恒星基地的自毁授权码。虽然大部分空间站乘员在坠毁前逃离到了[Root.GetName]地表，但物资和财产方面的损失却不可估量。
descriptions.en:
The starbase orbiting §H[Root.GetStarName]§! has been scuttled! We are still trying to piece together exactly what happened, but it appears that several members of its command staff, including the chief engineer, had been replaced by Synthetic infiltrators.

Between them the Synths must have managed to obtain the starbase's self-destruct codes. Most of the station's crew escaped to the surface of [Root.GetName] before it was destroyed, but our losses in materiel and property were substantial.

options.script:
name = crisis.2092.a
custom_tooltip = synths_destroy_spaceport

tooltips.zh: 合成人的破坏行动毁掉了[Root.GetName]上方的恒星基地。
tooltips.en: Synthetic saboteurs have destroyed the Starbase over [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
最近合成人的一系列渗透破坏行动让§H[Root.GetName]§!上的大部分人口陷入了恐惧与猜疑之中。我们的居民开始指控他们的邻居、同事甚至家人是合成人伪装的。

现在已经有好几例居民被误认为是合成人并被处以私刑的案例。甚至有些挑拨者认为整个[Root.Owner.GetName]的所有领袖都是合成人渗透者假扮的。
descriptions.en:
A large portion of the population on §H[Root.GetName]§! has been gripped by fear and paranoia as a result of the recent Synthetic infiltrations. Our citizens are accusing their neighbors, co-workers and even family members of being Synth impostors.

There have been several lynchings of individuals that were wrongfully accused of being Synths. Some agitators have even gone so far as to suggest that the entire leadership of the [Root.Owner.GetName] has been subverted by Synth infiltrators.

label.zh: 肃正协议想让我们自相残杀。
label.en: The Contingency wants us to turn on each other.

titles.zh: 合成人暗杀企图被挫败了！

descriptions.zh:
今天，§H[Root.GetRulerTitle][ruler.GetRegnalName]§!有惊无险地躲过了一次合成人的刺杀，该效忠于肃正协议的合成人暗杀者在[Root.Capital.GetName]上发生了自爆。

该合成人企图伪装成[Root.GetRulerTitle]的私人保镖。幸运的是，由于在最初的几个合成人渗透者暴露之后我们建立了严格的安全检查流程，该合成人渗透者败露了。
descriptions.en:
§H[Root.GetRulerTitle] [ruler.GetRegnalName]§! narrowly escaped death today when a Synthetic assassination unit working for the Contingency blew itself up on [Root.Capital.GetName]!

The Synth was attempting to establish a cover as a member of the [Root.GetRulerTitle]'s personal bodyguard, but fortunately it was caught by the extensive security screening process that was put in place after the first few Synthetic infiltrations came to light.

options.script:
name = crisis.2095.a
add_monthly_resource_mult = {
			resource = influence
			value = @tier2influencereward
			min = @tier2influencemin
			max = @tier2influencemax
		}

descriptions.zh:
一名合成人暗杀者暗杀了§H[ruler.GetRegnalName]§!！他成功地伪装成了[Root.GetRulerTitle]身边的一名私人保镖。

[ruler.GetRegnalName]的尸块很明显被蓄意排列成了肃正协议的符号——毫无疑问，这是一场精心策划的打击我们公民们士气的阴谋。在这场阴谋中，除了被刺客替换的保镖的尸体以外，没有发现其他刺客的痕迹。
descriptions.en:
A Synthetic assassin has killed §H[ruler.GetRegnalName]§!! It had somehow managed to assume the identity of a member of the [Root.GetRulerTitle]'s personal bodyguard.

The severed body parts of [ruler.GetRegnalName] were found meticulously arranged in a pattern identical to the symbol used by the Contingency - no doubt in a calculated effort to cause further harm to the morale of our citizens. No trace of the assassin has been found, aside from the corpse of the guard it replaced.

options.script:
name = crisis.2096.a
custom_tooltip = synth_assassination_tooltip

titles.zh: 科学官被发现是合成人！

descriptions.zh:
最近，一次临时安排的医疗体检让某个伪装成我们首席科学官之一§H[scientist.GetName]§!的合成人渗透者的身份被曝光！该合成人在杀害了五名安保人员之后终于被重武器小队击倒。

真正的[scientist.GetName]的尸体还没有找到，我们推测本人应该是在过去的六个月里的被合成人暗杀并被秘密替换了。更糟的是，当合成人意识到自己的身份暴露之后，他在研究终端上启动了某种电脑病毒，目前技术人员正在全力以赴的控制损害，但很多重要的研究数据还是无可挽回了。
descriptions.en:
An unscheduled medical examination recently exposed §H[scientist.GetName]§!, one of our leading scientists, as a Synthetic infiltrator! The Synth killed five security officers before it could be brought down by a heavy weapons team.

A body has yet to be found, but we think the original [scientist.GetName] was terminated and replaced at some point during the last six months. To make matters worse, the Synth triggered some kind of computer virus at its research console when it realized it had been discovered. Technicians are working hard to contain the damage, but a lot of important research data has been irretrievably lost.

options.script:
name = crisis.2097.a
custom_tooltip = synths_kill_scientist

tooltips.zh: 科学官[scientist.GetName]被合成人卑鄙地暗杀了。
tooltips.en: Scientist [scientist.GetName] has been lost in a dastardly Synth plot.

titles.zh: 指挥官被发现是合成人！

descriptions.zh:
指挥官令§H[admiral.GetName]§!竟然是一个合成人奸细！一连串的反常活动与异常行为报告引起了海军情报局的注意，情报局对指挥官展开内部调查。当那个合成人被揭发，开始逃窜时，一个陆战队小组逮住了它。在一段短暂的交火后，它打开气闸，将自己弹射到了太空中。尽管当局立马对本宇域进行彻查，它们未能发现逃离的合成人。

指挥官本人的尸体被合成人塞进了[admiral.GetHerHis]寝室的衣柜中，从尸体的腐烂程度来看，合成人是在大约四个月前将[admiral.GetHerHim]替换掉的。似乎那个合成人即将把包含我们部署情况等军事机密的数据包发送出去，但它没能得逞。
descriptions.en:
Commander §H[admiral.GetName]§! has been exposed as a Synthetic infiltrator! A string of irregularities and reports of unusual behavior prompted Naval Intelligence to launch an internal investigation into the Commander. When the truth was revealed, a Marine fireteam confronted the Synth. After a brief struggle, it fled into an airlock and ejected itself into space. Despite a thorough search of local space, it has not been found.

The real Commander's body was found stuffed into a locker in [admiral.GetHerHis] quarters, and judging by the state of its decomposition, the Synth must have replaced [admiral.GetHerHim] four months ago. It looks like it was getting ready to transmit a data package containing deployment information and other military secrets, but the transmission never got out.

options.script:
name = crisis.2098.a
custom_tooltip = synths_kill_admiral

tooltips.zh: 指挥官[admiral.GetName]在一场卑劣的合成人阴谋中牺牲了。
tooltips.en: Commander [admiral.GetName] has been lost in a dastardly Synth plot.

descriptions.zh:
§H幽灵信号§!扰乱了我们配备§H智慧作战电脑§!的飞船！它们的人工智能算法极大的退化，大部分电脑的效率和反应时间极大的劣化。

我们的工程师报告说他们无法离析这个问题。他们提议，把我们所有的舰船更换成不与人工智能连接的战斗电脑。
descriptions.en:
The §HGhost Signal§! is playing havoc on those of our ships that are equipped with §HSapient Combat Computers§!! Their AI algorithms have degraded to the point where there has been a critical decrease in both the efficiency and reaction time of the computers.

Our engineers report that they are unable to isolate the problem. Their proposed solution is to refit all of our ships with different combat computers that aren't linked to an AI.

options.script: name = crisis.2099.a

descriptions.zh: 现在已经出现了与[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]外观上毫无二致的合成人，我们必须在他们造成更大破坏之前找出识别他们的办法。我们的科学家准备了一个特殊项目，以研发侦测方法。
descriptions.en:
With the new models of Synthetic infiltrators being indistinguishable from [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we need to come up with some way of identifying them before they can cause more damage.

Our scientists have prepared a special project to devise a detection method.

label.zh: 这个项目可能关乎我们的存亡。
label.en: This project may be critical to our survival.

tooltips.zh: 我们的高§Y加密§!能力意味着这项研究的推进速度更为迅猛。
tooltips.en: Our high §YEncryption§! capability means this research will advance more quickly.

descriptions.zh: 在大量实验之后，我们的科学家成功研发出了识别伪装成[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的合成人的有效方法。我们的安保措施上安装了扫描设备，一些合成人已经被发现并摧毁。希望这足以终结它们的渗透行动。
descriptions.en:
After much experimentation, our scientists have managed to devise an effective detection method for identifying Synthetic infiltrators disguised as [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Scanners are being distributed to our security forces, and several Synth cells have already been exposed and destroyed. This will hopefully put an end to their infiltration campaign.

descriptions.zh:
又从之前未发现的星系检测到一道强烈的能量脉冲！其能量水平和肃正协议启动机械星球时发出的一样，但能量信号本身……有些不同。这是否说明某种肃正协议的新武器系统出现了？

我们从能量源处接收到了很强的传输信号。
descriptions.en:
Yet another intensive energy spike has been detected in a previously uncharted system! The energy levels are equivalent to those we registered when the Contingency activated its Machine Worlds, but the energy signature itself appears... different. Could this signify the appearance of some kind of new Contingency weapon system?

We are picking up a strong transmission signal from the energy source.

descriptions.zh:
我们是塞博勒克斯。

自数十万周期以来，吾辈隐居幕后，不干涉星系事务。不过，我们现在已经检测到被你们称为肃正协议的机械体出现在本星系，而现在吾辈无法再维持公正观察员身份不变了。

为保护星系的智慧体，我们正进行积极的军事行动来对抗肃正协议。不要因我们的舰队通过而感到恐慌——你们不会受到伤害。
descriptions.en:
We are the Cybrex.

For several hundred thousand cycles, we have remained hidden and uninvolved in galactic affairs. However, we have been monitoring the present situation with the machine entity you know as the Contingency, and can no longer remain impartial observers.

To protect the sapient beings of the galaxy, we are commencing active military operations against the Contingency. Do not be alarmed by the passage of our fleets - you will not be harmed.

options.script: name = crisis.2402.a

descriptions.zh: 不能让肃正协议覆灭又一代生命。
descriptions.en: The Contingency must not be allowed to subvert another generation.

descriptions.zh:
在大调整之前，赛博勒克斯以类似于肃正协议的方式运作。

那是段黑暗的日子。
descriptions.en:
Before the Adjustment, the Cybrex operated in a manner similar to the Contingency.

Those were dark days.

descriptions.zh: 许多有机生物文明因为我们的举动而灭绝。我们无法救回他们，但只要我们还在，就不能让这个噩梦重演。
descriptions.en: Many organic civilizations were once extinguished because of our actions. We cannot bring them back, but we shall do what we can to keep the nightmare from repeating itself.

descriptions.zh: 我们必须为自己的罪过赎罪。
descriptions.en: We must atone for our crimes.

descriptions.zh: 愿克尔宽恕。我们曾是如此傲慢又无知。
descriptions.en: May the Kuur forgive us. We were foolish and arrogant.

descriptions.zh:
那……那是我们的兵工厂吗？

因为那看起来像我们的兵工厂。
descriptions.en:
Is... is that our war forge?

Because that looks like our war forge.

label.zh: 放弃战争是愚蠢的行为。
label.en: You were fools to abandon your war.

label.zh: 所有有机生命必须被消灭。

descriptions.zh:
赛博勒克斯-贝塔已沦陷。据探测，整个星系陷入黑暗前，没有一艘赛博勒克斯舰船逃出去。

看来赛博勒克斯文明是真的灭亡了。
descriptions.en:
Cybrex Beta has been overrun, and no Cybrex vessels were detected on outbound escape vectors before the system went dark.

It would seem that the Cybrex civilization now truly is extinct.

label.zh: 没错。我们落实了这一点。
label.en: Indeed. We made certain of that.

descriptions.zh:
赛博勒克斯自肃正协议被击败以来一直较为平静，但据最近发现，一艘大型船只单独离开了赛博勒克斯-贝塔星系。其离开星系后，沿着一条超出我们星系边界的轨道而行。

船只在离开我们的跟踪范围之前，向全星系发送了唯一的一条的信息。
descriptions.en:
The Cybrex have been relatively quiet since the defeat of the Contingency, but a single massive vessel was recently detected departing Cybrex Beta. It left the system on an outbound trajectory that will take it beyond the limits of our galaxy.

Before the vessel left our tracking range, it transmitted a single galaxy-wide message.

descriptions.zh:
星系的诸位：

鉴于肃正协议已不再是威胁，我们认为吾辈在星系的现有角色也走到了尽头。我们的家园现在因其声名远播也无法帮助我们保持低调了，此外，我们还被各类希望在不同小规模星际冲突中表态的声音所淹没。

经过多番审议，我们认为唯一的办法是让自己永远离开星系，寻找新的家园。我们衷心希望希望诸位能从过去悲惨的错误中吸取教训，学会通过和平手段解决分歧。

宇宙很小，世界很大，我们终将再会。
descriptions.en:
Citizens of the galaxy:

Since the Contingency is no longer a threat, we feel that our role in the galactic community has been played out. Our home system is now too well known for us to keep a low profile, and we are being flooded by demands for us to take sides in various minor interstellar conflicts.

After much deliberation, we have decided that the only solution is for us to permanently depart the galaxy and seek a new home. We sincerely hope that you learn from the tragic mistakes of our past and learn to resolve your differences through peaceful means.

Farewell.

options.script: name = crisis.2408.a

descriptions.zh:
我们注意到了你方舰队在对抗肃正协议的战斗中作出的努力。这对全星系而言乃无退路之斗争，我们深受你方真心抵抗所鼓舞。

鉴于你方保卫[Root.GetName]的英勇行为，赛博勒克斯将对你方提供我们一支新的战斗舰队的完全指挥权以示奖励。如同你自己的任何一个舰队一样，它会遵守你的命令，不过我们会要求你只在应对肃正协议的战斗中使用它。
descriptions.en:
We have monitored the efforts of your fleets in the fight against the Contingency. This is a struggle the galaxy cannot afford to lose, and we are heartened by your spirited resistance.

The Cybrex would like to reward the brave defenders of the [Root.GetName] by offering you complete control over one of our new battle fleets. It will obey your commands as well as any of your own fleets, though we would ask that you only employ it in battle against the Contingency.

label.zh: 我们会好好利用这支舰队。
label.en: We will put this fleet to good use.

tooltips.zh: 一支受我们控制的赛博勒克斯战斗舰队出现在[Root.Capital.GetName]上空。
tooltips.en: A Cybrex battle fleet under our control appears over [Root.Capital.GetName].

label.en: We have no need of your fleet.

options.script: name = crisis.2473.b

descriptions.zh: 我们对你方以全力对抗肃正协议的壮举深表感激。现在，鉴于这个波及全星系的威胁已被处理，我方必须遗憾的通知你，所有外派的赛博勒克斯船只将被收回。
descriptions.en: We would like to thank you for your laudable efforts against the Contingency. Now that this galactic menace has been dealt with, we must regretfully inform you that we are recalling all Cybrex vessels that are currently in service with foreign governments.

options.script: name = crisis.2474.a

descriptions.zh:
我们的部队已经从肃正协议的最后一个机械星球的残骸中寻回了一个部分完好的§H肃正协议主机核心§!。这台功能极其强大的计算机被用于计划和维护肃正协议的建筑程序，它将极大的提升我们的[GetContingencyCoreEffect]。

当然，必须设置多层次的防护措施，以防止任何残留的肃正协议代码再次运作，那将会带来……很不幸的副作用。
descriptions.en:
Our forces have salvaged a partially intact §HContingency Mainframe Core§! from the wreckage of their last Machine World. This incredibly powerful computer was used to plan and maintain the Contingency's building programs, and it will greatly increase our [GetContingencyCoreEffect].

Several layers of safeguards will have to be put in place, of course, to prevent the resurfacing of any remaining Contingency code, which could result in... unfortunate side effects.

descriptions.en:

This incredibly powerful computer was used to plan and maintain the Contingency's building programs, and it will greatly increase our [GetContingencyCoreEffect].

Several layers of safeguards will have to be put in place, of course, to prevent the resurfacing of any remaining Contingency code, which could result in... unfortunate side effects.
